scope: C147/D119. Constraint-projected real Gaussian (Wigner) inflaton zero-mode states at a time-symmetric Casimir turning point, classical nonlinear propagation; WKB analysis of the T^3 Casimir forbidden region. Not the joint WDW wavefunction or its physical inner product.

T5_C145_interface.anchor: y = N_post - 68.3913 (xi=0.30, instant reheating; v11 Sec. IV D) [input]

center_prior_options (state-input).inner_tunneling_like: p(y) ~ exp(+alpha y) up to N_max; P(read|no circles) ~ 0
